# Eye Rest

> A calm, hand-painted macOS menu-bar app that enforces the 20-20-20 eye-rest rule with full-screen painterly break scenes. Free to start; Pro is a one-time $14.99 (no subscription), macOS 14+.

Eye Rest reminds knowledge workers to rest their eyes on the 20-20-20 rule and turns each break into a hand-painted scene they'll actually take. Differentiator: beauty drives adherence — unlike utilitarian break apps (LookAway, Time Out, Stretchly) that get uninstalled.
